note.zh: 三条街，一个晚上。天桥上的车流、雨停之后的便利店、天黑前最后十分钟的天台——城市在夜里把音量调低，反而听得更清楚。
note.en: Three streets, one night: traffic off the footbridge, a convenience store after the rain, the last ten minutes of light on a rooftop. The city turns its volume down at night, and you hear more.

desc.zh: 天桥上等了四十分钟，车流在下面拖成一条条光线。
desc.en: Forty minutes on the footbridge, traffic smearing into light below.

desc.zh: 雨刚停，整条街只剩这一块亮着。
desc.en: The rain had just stopped; this was the only lit thing on the street.

desc.zh: 天黑之前最后十分钟，楼顶风很大。
desc.en: The last ten minutes before dark, and it was windy up there.
